newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels to launch $200 mln debt - source.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels to launch $200 mln debt - source.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp is expected to issue $200 million of five-year debt on Wednesday through a Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities syndicate, market sources said.
The deal will be launched on Wednesday morning, according to one source.

Hilton Hotel's senior unsecured debt ratings are Baa1 from Moody's Investors Service and BBB-plus from Standard & Poor's. Both agencies said they may lower Hilton's ratings in light of the company's proposed acquisition of ITT Corp.
